SELECT l.operator_source_code AS operator_code, l.operator_name,
CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS line_id, l.name AS line_name,
CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS station_id, s.name AS station_name
FROM railway_lines l
INNER JOIN stations s ON s.line_id = l.id
WHERE l.status = 1 AND s.status = 1 AND l.operator_source_code IS NOT NULL AND l.operator_source_code != '' AND l.operator_name IS NOT NULL AND l.operator_name != ''
ORDER BY l.operator_source_code ASC, l.sort_order ASC, l.id ASC, s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT l.operator_source_code AS `value`, l.operator_name AS label
FROM railway_lines l
WHERE l.status = 1 AND l.operator_source_code IS NOT NULL AND l.operator_source_code != '' AND l.operator_name IS NOT NULL AND l.operator_name != ''
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stations s WHERE s.line_id = l.id AND s.status = 1 )
GROUP BY l.operator_source_code, l.operator_name
ORDER BY MIN(l.sort_order) ASC, l.operator_source_code ASC

SELECT CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS `value`, l.name AS label
FROM railway_lines l
WHERE l.operator_source_code = #{operatorCode} AND l.status = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stations s WHERE s.line_id = l.id AND s.status = 1 )
ORDER BY l.sort_order ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS `value`, s.name AS label
FROM stations s
INNER JOIN railway_lines l ON l.id = s.line_id
WHERE s.line_id = #{lineId} AND s.status = 1 AND l.status = 1
ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT s.id, s.name, l.name AS line_name, s.prefecture_code, s.area_code, s.latitude, s.longitude
FROM stations s
INNER JOIN railway_lines l ON l.id = s.line_id
WHERE s.status = 1 AND l.status = 1
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT( '%', REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE(#{keyword}, '=', '=='), '%', '=%' ), '_', '=_' ), '%' ) ESCAPE '='
AND s.prefecture_code = #{prefectureCode}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.name = #{keyword} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.name ASC, l.sort_order ASC, l.id ASC, s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
